source.snippet: User managing a truck split between Turo rental income (Schedule C) and rental property management (Schedule E) finds TurboTax 2025 does not correctly handle combined business-use percentage across multiple schedules for MACRS depreciation. Score: 3.

problem_statement: Small business owners with mixed-use assets (personal vehicle used across multiple business activities like gig rentals and rental property management) cannot correctly calculate combined business-use percentages in consumer tax software, risking mis-depreciation and IRS exposure.
target_segment: US-based solo operators and small landlords with multi-schedule tax situations (Schedule C + E) using TurboTax or similar DIY tax software
notes: Buyer signal: user is an active small business owner managing real assets (truck, Turo rentals, rental properties) with real tax liability. They use paid TurboTax. Pain is concrete: software fails on a multi-schedule edge case. Opportunity is niche tax tooling or guided workflow for multi-income solo operators.
